reasoning_summary: The failing tests demonstrate that the compiler's name-uniquing logic (MakeDeclaredNamesUnique) is failing to correctly handle variable scope inversion and local name uniqueness. It is not a missing guard (Checking), a simple initialization error (Assignment), or a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object).

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the bug involves relationships between scopes, the root cause is the implementation of the name-uniquing algorithm itself, not a failure to maintain consistency between two separate, pre-existing structures.
